name: Uniform Echo Spacing
description: Echo spacing (dTE) must be uniform for R2*/beat fitting. (From the HC-ChiSep Validation Protocol schema.)
implementation:
te = value["EchoTime"].dropna().sort_values()
d = te.diff().iloc[1:]
if not all(abs(d.iloc[0] - s) < 0.1 for s in d):
    raise ValidationError(f"Echo spacing not uniform. Found {list(d.round(2))}.")
